episode_summary: Barely Informed News exposed a wave of pig butchering scams on Truth Social draining elderly users of hundreds of thousands of dollars, then pivoted to a prostate milking tutorial from Jeb Nogget's woodshop — where his deceased father revealed the Stonehaven family's ancestral 'ass wizard' lineage. Peter Gibbon hijacked the desk to profile a car wash voyeur, Liliana documented the rising snake therapy trend, Trip Bradstein weathered a parade of park grotesques including his Truth Social-scammed grandmother, and DJ Newsic closed with a musical scam rundown featuring a shady legal expert shilling his own crypto coin.
